beverage-syrup-jet-mixing.title: Beverage syrup preparation: complete control of a jet mixing system
beverage-syrup-jet-mixing.cardTitle: Syrup jet mixing system on Siemens S7-1200 and SIMATIC HMI
beverage-syrup-jet-mixing.summary: A complete control system for the syrup preparation of a beverage plant. It uses a Siemens S7-1200 PLC, a SIMATIC HMI at the tank and two Yaskawa VFDs for pump speed. The system fills the jet mixer tanks and circulates the syrup automatically.
beverage-syrup-jet-mixing.seoTitle: Syrup Jet Mixing Control | Siemens S7-1200
beverage-syrup-jet-mixing.seoDescription: Syrup jet mixing control for a beverage plant in Egypt: Siemens S7-1200 PLC, SIMATIC HMI, two Yaskawa pump drives and a CIP-ready interlock.
beverage-syrup-jet-mixing.challenge: A beverage plant needed a complete control system for its syrup preparation. The radial jet mixing system had to fill its mixer tanks and circulate the syrup at a controlled pump speed for a set time. It also had to work with the plant's CIP system, all operated from a screen at the tank.
solution: We designed the control system around a Siemens S7-1200 PLC with I/O modules and two Yaskawa VFDs. A Siemens SIMATIC HMI sits at the tank, in a stainless-steel enclosure with an emergency stop. The PLC runs the process sequence in automatic mode: filling of the jet mixer tank, circulation against a time setpoint, and control of the process valves.

The VFDs control pump speed, and the HMI shows the speed setpoint and actual value next to the live tank level. The CIP-ready status is used as an interlock and shown on the screen, and alarms are reset from the HMI.
We integrated the instruments and I/O, including a pressure switch, then tested and commissioned the system and optimized the process on site.
scope: Control panel with a Siemens S7-1200 PLC, I/O modules and two Yaskawa VFDs
SIMATIC HMI screens for the jet mixer tanks
Filling, circulation and valve sequence in automatic mode
Pump speed control with setpoint and actual value
Tank level, circulation timers and CIP-ready interlock
beverage-syrup-jet-mixing.result: The syrup preparation system runs its filling and circulation sequence automatically, and operators follow pump speed, tank level, circulation time and interlock status on the HMI at the tank.
highlights: Pump speed on two Yaskawa VFDs

After testing every I/O point, sensor and actuator, we commissioned the machine under actual operating conditions and fine-tuned the parameters for filling accuracy.

bottle-printing-motion-retrofit.seoDescription: Legacy bottle printing machine in Egypt upgraded to PLC and motion control: synchronized bottle positioning, new logic, I/O tests, commissioning.
bottle-printing-motion-retrofit.challenge: A legacy machine that prints pharmaceutical and cosmetic bottles needed better printing accuracy, higher reliability and better production efficiency. The owner wanted to keep the existing machine and extend its service life.
solution: We upgraded the complete control system to a PLC with motion control. We programmed and synchronized the machine motion so that each bottle is positioned precisely for printing. We also reworked the control logic and operating sequence, and tuned the motion parameters for fast and accurate operation.
All field devices and control signals were tested before commissioning under real operating conditions.

anaerobic-waste-treatment-commissioning.title: Waste treatment system: testing and commissioning at a food and beverage plant
anaerobic-waste-treatment-commissioning.summary: Testing and commissioning of an anaerobic waste treatment system: instrument and I/O checks, logic and interlock validation, gradual start-up and punch-list closure.
anaerobic-waste-treatment-commissioning.seoDescription: Testing and commissioning of an anaerobic waste treatment system at a food and beverage plant in Egypt: I/O tests, interlocks, gradual start-up.
anaerobic-waste-treatment-commissioning.challenge: A waste processing system built around an anaerobic reactor had to be brought into continuous operation at a food and beverage plant. Instruments, wiring, control logic and safety functions all needed verification first.
solution: Our scope was testing and commissioning. We verified the field instruments and electrical connections. Then we tested every I/O signal between the field and the control system, a Siemens S7-200 SMART PLC with an MCGS HMI. We also validated the control logic and operating sequences, and tested the safety interlocks and protection functions.
We then started the system up gradually under real operating conditions, tuned the operating parameters and resolved the commissioning observations.
scope: I/O testing between field devices and the control system
anaerobic-waste-treatment-commissioning.result: The system was handed over ready for continuous operation, with all commissioning observations resolved.

commercial-laundry-washer-control.title: Laundry washer control: recipes by fabric and soil level, with detergent dosing
commercial-laundry-washer-control.cardTitle: Laundry washer control on Wecon PLC and HMI
commercial-laundry-washer-control.summary: A Wecon PLC and HMI control system for a laundry washer: programs by fabric type and soil level, automatic fill, wash, rinse and extract, and control of water, temperature and dosing.
commercial-laundry-washer-control.seoDescription: Laundry washer control in Egypt on Wecon PLC and HMI: recipes by fabric and soil level, water, temperature and detergent dosing. Video.
commercial-laundry-washer-control.challenge: Hotel and commercial laundries wash many types of linen. The washer needed programs for each fabric type and soil level, precise control of water, temperature and detergent, and efficient, reliable operation that uses water and energy carefully.
solution: Fill, wash, rinse and extract now run automatically, and the program controls water level, temperature and detergent dosing. Multiple programmable recipes cover different fabrics and soil levels. The control system runs on a Wecon PLC with a Wecon HMI.

The HMI shows real-time status, alarms and fault messages, safety interlocks protect the operator and the machine, and the system logs operating data for performance monitoring. Before installation, the program was run and checked on the HMI on the bench.

Water level, temperature and detergent dosing control
commercial-laundry-washer-control.result: The washer runs each program automatically for the fabric and soil level selected, with controlled water, temperature and dosing, and operators see status and faults on the HMI.

pasteurizer-cip-recipes.title: Pasteurizer control system with CIP, recipes and flow diversion
pasteurizer-cip-recipes.cardTitle: Pasteurizer with CIP and recipes on Wecon PLC and HMI
pasteurizer-cip-recipes.summary: Automated control of a pasteurizer on Wecon PLC and HMI: temperature and holding-time control, flow regulation, product recipes, CIP and interlocks that stop under-processed product from leaving the machine.
pasteurizer-cip-recipes.seoDescription: Pasteurizer automation in Egypt: a flow-diversion interlock holds back under-temperature product, plus CIP, recipes per product and data logging.
pasteurizer-cip-recipes.challenge: The pasteurizer had to hold the correct temperature and holding time for each product, keep heat distribution uniform, and never discharge product that had not met pasteurization conditions. It also needed cleaning-in-place and simple operation for several products.
solution: Each product now gets its own temperature and holding time from the PLC, held with proportional control and adjustable pulse settings. The PLC also regulates product flow and runs the feed, master and heating pumps with timed start and stop delays. The system runs on a Wecon LX3V PLC with a Wecon HMI.

Flow-diversion valve (FDV) logic, with adjustable switching points and a safety temperature, prevents under-temperature product from being discharged. The HMI has screens for manual and automatic operation, CIP, settings, recipes and alarms, and the system logs production data for performance analysis.
scope: Wecon HMI with Manual, Automatic, CIP, Settings, Recipes and Alarms screens
Temperature and holding-time control for each product
Flow-diversion valve logic and safety interlocks
pasteurizer-cip-recipes.result: Each product is pasteurized at its set temperature and time, under-processed product is held back automatically, and operators run production and CIP from one HMI. Production data is logged for performance analysis.

labeling-machine-delta-wecon.title: Labeling machine: synchronized control with recipes and label checks
labeling-machine-delta-wecon.cardTitle: Labeling machine on Delta PLC and Wecon HMI
labeling-machine-delta-wecon.summary: A control system for a labeling machine on Delta PLC and Wecon HMI, with stepper-driven label dispensing, line synchronization, product recipes and missing-label detection.
labeling-machine-delta-wecon.seoTitle: Labeling Machine | Delta PLC & Wecon HMI
labeling-machine-delta-wecon.seoDescription: Labeling machine control in Egypt on Delta PLC and Wecon HMI: stepper-driven label dispensing, line sync, product recipes, missing-label checks.
labeling-machine-delta-wecon.challenge: The labeling machine had to place labels accurately at line speed, handle several product sizes and label formats, and catch missing or misaligned labels before products moved on.
solution: The labeler now runs in step with the production line. The PLC controls labeling speed and position, using Schneider Electric stepper drives and an Altivar variable-speed drive. The control system is built on a Delta DVP PLC with a Wecon HMI.

Product settings, including label length, dispense length, speeds and gate and stepper delays, are stored in a product table on the HMI. Sensors detect bottles, labels and the gate position, and the system flags missing or misaligned labels. The HMI shows real-time status and alarms, and the system logs production data.
scope: Wecon HMI with Main, Settings, Calibration and Alarms screens
Labeling speed, position and line synchronization
Product table for sizes and label formats
labeling-machine-delta-wecon.result: The labeler switches between products by loading their stored settings, places labels in step with the line, and flags missing or misaligned labels before the products move on.

olive-autoclave-sterilization.title: Olive sterilization autoclave: temperature, pressure and time control
olive-autoclave-sterilization.cardTitle: Olive sterilization autoclave on LS PLC
olive-autoclave-sterilization.summary: Automated sterilization control for an olive autoclave on LS PLC and HMI: multi-phase cycles with temperature, pressure and time setpoints, alarms and traceable records.
olive-autoclave-sterilization.seoDescription: Olive autoclave sterilization control in Egypt on LS PLC and HMI: time, temperature and pressure for each phase, alarms, traceable cycle records.
olive-autoclave-sterilization.challenge: Sterilization must reach and hold the right temperature, pressure and time for each olive type and batch size, in every cycle, and each cycle should leave a record for quality assurance.
solution: Each sterilization program now runs in phases, with time, temperature and pressure setpoints for every phase and the live values on the screen. The controller is an LS PLC with an expansion module, operated from an HMI.

The PLC controls steam, water, air, pressure compensation, the pump, filling and drain, and monitors the door status. Programs cover different olive types and batch sizes, alarms appear on the HMI, and cycle data is logged for traceability.

Steam, water, air and drain valve control
olive-autoclave-sterilization.result: Each olive type and batch size has its own phase program, the PLC holds time, temperature and pressure through every phase, and each cycle is logged for quality assurance.

tablet-coating-scada.title: Tablet coating machine: PLC and SCADA control for pharmaceutical production
tablet-coating-scada.cardTitle: Tablet coating machine on Siemens S7-1200 and WinCC
tablet-coating-scada.summary: Siemens S7-1200 and WinCC Professional SCADA control for a tablet film-coating machine: spray rate, pan speed, air temperature, process time and formulation recipes.

cheese-cooker-recipes.seoDescription: Cheese cooker control in Egypt on Wecon PLC and HMI: six-step recipes with time, motor speed and direction, plus temperature and valve control.
cheese-cooker-recipes.challenge: Cheese texture and taste depend on temperature, cooking time and mixing. Each cheese type needed its own settings, and operators needed to run them the same way in every batch.
solution: Each cheese type now has its own six-step program, and every step sets its own time and the direction and speed of two mixing motors. A VEICHI VFD handles speed control, and the system runs on a Wecon PLC with expansion I/O and a Wecon HMI.
The PLC controls the cooking temperature against its setpoint and operates the steam, double-jacket and discharge valves. Programs are saved by number and name and loaded for each cheese type.

Steam, jacket and discharge valve control
cheese-cooker-recipes.result: Each cheese type is cooked from its own saved program, called up by number and name, so every batch follows the same temperature, time and mixing steps.

hotel-washer-extractor-control.title: Hotel washer-extractor: a 15-step wash program editor with five chemical inputs
hotel-washer-extractor-control.cardTitle: Hotel washer-extractor on Wecon PLC and HMI
hotel-washer-extractor-control.summary: Wecon PLC and HMI control for hotel washing machines, with a 15-step program editor for towels, bed sheets, uniforms and other items.
hotel-washer-extractor-control.seoDescription: Hotel washer-extractor control in Egypt on Wecon PLC and HMI: a 15-step wash program editor, five chemical inputs, level and temperature control.
hotel-washer-extractor-control.challenge: A hotel laundry washes towels, bed sheets and uniforms, and each needs a different wash. The machines needed flexible programs that staff could change easily, with consistent results and less manual work.
solution: Laundry staff now build wash programs of up to 15 steps on the HMI, such as prewash, wash, rinse, drain and extract. Each step has its own time, water level, hot or cold water, temperature and selection of five chemical inputs. The system runs on a Wecon PLC with a Wecon HMI.
The main screen shows drum direction, door lock, water level, steam, drain and chemical status, with step and program timers.
scope: Water level, temperature and water-source control
hotel-washer-extractor-control.result: Laundry staff build and change wash programs on the HMI themselves, up to 15 steps per program, and each type of linen is washed with its own program every time.
